subject: Thank you for contacting Happy Valley Volleyball Club
message:
Thank you for reaching out to Happy Valley Volleyball Club! Your message is important to us, and we will get back to you as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience and your interest in HVVC!

In the meantime, these resources may help:
• **Tryout & Season FAQs:** [Read our FAQs](/faq/)
• **Tryout Registration:** [Register here](https://hvvc.leagueapps.com/events/5181386-hvvc-202627-tryout-registration)
• **Club Updates:** [Visit our website](/)

**Team information, financial commitment details, season dues and Scholarship information will be posted on our [Investment](/investment/) page by October 20.**

announcements.text: **Save The Date!** We are hosting a **Pre-Tryout Parent Meeting on Tuesday, October 20, from 6:30 to 8:00 PM in the Beatrice Cannady Elementary gym.** We’d love to have you join us to learn more about the season and ask questions!

closing:
Thank you again for your patience. I’m excited for the season ahead!

See You on The Court!
~ Happy Valley Volleyball Club
